declaration.preface: Cherry Hill Interiors Pvt. Ltd. upholds the highest ethical standards in the workplace, ensuring fair labor practices, human rights, and a culture of integrity. We strive to maintain a safe, inclusive, and equitable work environment that respects the dignity and well-being of all employees and stakeholders. Our approach integrates ethical business conduct, diversity and inclusion, health and safety measures, and compliance with all relevant regulations, including ISO 18001:2007 (Occupational Health & Safety Management), Occupational Safety and Health Act (OSHA), the International Labour Organization (ILO) conventions, the Universal Declaration of Human Rights (UDHR), and national labor laws. Through continuous improvement, training, and engagement, we foster a workplace built on fairness, transparency, and accountability.
declaration.declaration: Ethical responsibility and inclusivity form the foundation of Cherry Hill Interiors Pvt. Ltd.’s workplace culture. With 2022 as our baseline year, we ensure to achieve our set targets in   compliance with labor laws, human rights frameworks, and industry benchmarks. This policy reinforces our dedication to workplace safety, ethical employment practices, and transparent stakeholder engagement. Through governance, training, and collaboration, we continuously strengthen our workplace ethics and uphold the highest standards of integrity.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all business operations, including office spaces, project sites, supply chains, and interactions with stakeholders. It extends to employees, contractors, suppliers, and partners engaged in our business activities.

policy.monitoring:
Cherry Hill Interiors monitors its labour and human rights performance across key areas, including workplace health and safety, ethical working conditions, employee engagement, learning and development, diversity and inclusion, prevention of child and forced labour, and the protection of human rights across its value chain. Relevant Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) are tracked through established internal processes to assess progress against the company's objectives and commitments.

Performance is reviewed periodically by management to support informed decision-making and continuous improvement. Regular assessments are conducted to identify achievements, gaps, and improvement opportunities, with appropriate corrective actions implemented where necessary. Relevant information is communicated to stakeholders, as appropriate, to promote transparency and accountability. All monitoring and reporting activities are conducted in alignment with applicable labour laws, internationally recognized human rights principles, and industry best practices.
policy.reviewMechanism:
The Labor and Human Rights Policy is reviewed once after every two years or as required by the Human Resources Manager to ensure compliance with regulations and best practices.

Annual audits assess policy effectiveness, identify gaps, and drive improvements.

Employee and stakeholder feedback is gathered to refine policy execution.

Corrective actions are implemented based on audit findings to enhance workplace conditions.

Compliance reports and updates are presented to senior management for accountability and continuous improvement.

Benchmarking against industry standards ensures leadership in ethical workplace practices.
